name: go-cli
description: > Build command-line tools in Go: flag handling, subcommands, stdin/stdout discipline, exit codes, signal handling, and when Cobra/Viper earn their weight over the standard library. Use when: "build a CLI", "add a subcommand", "parse flags", "exit codes", "handle Ctrl+C", "cobra command", "read from stdin", "CLI UX". Do NOT use for: HTTP API design (use go-api-design), project scaffolding in general (use go-project-layout), or configuration of services (use go-architecture-review).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 一套用 Go 构建命令行工具的实践指南，适合处理参数解析、子命令、输入输出、退出码、信号响应及框架选型。
